CONTAINERS.description: the sections of a page, each built by `DSSectionContainer`, or by `DSFeatureGridSectionContainer` for a grid section
CONTAINERS.layoutCases: a section's content kind is chosen first, and its case second: BESIDE puts the picture at the end side of the words (SPLIT_END), UNDER under them (MEDIA_BOTTOM), HEAD_ACROSS the head across the top with the items under it; a kind's case states only what differs from that

WIDGETS.description: the units placed beside others; a widget that shows an item states its forms as its cases, by where it stands (GRID_CELL, LIST_ROW, SIDE_LIST, SLIDE) and what it holds (WITH_PICTURE, WORDS_ONLY), and a container's case names the form it takes
